translations.web: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
translations.bsb: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
translations.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
translations.asv: And they blindfolded him, and asked him, saying, Prophesy: who is he that struck thee?
